title: Other-root placement notice makes a synchronous held-claims CLI read on the runtime event path when a test starts
outcome: A recognised test starting in a session that named roots for other held claims never blocks the runtime event handler on an Engram held-claims read: the optional placement notice is computed off that path or from a recent snapshot.
acceptance: EngramOtherRootNoticeRead does not call read_held_claims synchronously on the command-start observation path; a test with a parked held-claims transport shows that runtime frame processing proceeds while the read is outstanding, and the notice is still applied when it is current.

completion.summary: Other-root placement reads run in owned background observers; deterministic parked-read tests show runtime progress and current-notice publication. Delivered on master, native registered check PASS3. Closed under restored evaluation-OFF policy with failed-window limit recorded.
